title: Hungar's Episcopal Church Graveyard
description:
A digital Graveyard preservation project for the Historic Hungars Episcopal Parish.
Explore the property or visit a grave. Move around in 3D to explore, and view a high-resolution photo of each headstone by opening the info bubble at each stone. Use a VR headset to experience the site in-person. Photorealism takes a moment to load; please be patient.

Credits:
Hungars' Cure parish site:
http://hungarscureparish.org/
Hungars' Graveyard Documentation that was referred to in this project:
https://www.hungarscureparish.org/_files/ugd/ae38be_32f13ed488a843c9aafd728451032a51.pdf

Tour made by Gaudeor Rudmin using Spark Tour Studio:
https://github.com/MisterE123/spark-tour-studio
Captured on a Pocket 3D with DJI Osmo and a Mini 4 pro drone.

SACRED  
TO THE MEMORY  
OF  
THE REV. STEPHEN S. GUNTER  
who was born in Accomack County E. S. Va.  
on the 20th of July 1792.  
He was chosen Rector of Hungars Parish in 1825  
where he continued  
until October the 1st 1835,  
when he was called at the age of 43 years  
to the rest which remaineth for the people of God.  
Let me die the death of the righteous and let my last end be like his.
This stone is erected by his parishioners
as a tribute of their affectionate rememberance.
